title: Prayer Customs
summary: Prayer in biblical settings could be private, public, temple-centered, synagogue-connected, or tied to appointed times and postures.
background: The New Testament shows prayer in homes, synagogues, the temple, upper rooms, prison, and mission settings. Jesus also warns against prayer used for display.
teachingHelp: When teaching prayer customs, keep the emphasis on communion with God, humility, faith, and the heart—not merely posture or location.
